answer.explanation: After the $12,000 deposit, the total portfolio value is $112,000. Target allocations are 60% STOCK ($67,200), 30% BOND ($33,600), and 10% CASH ($11,200). Complying with the restriction not to sell AAPL (100 shares at $220 = $22,000, which is 19.64% of the final portfolio, satisfying the max 25% individual stock limit), we sell 25 shares of MSFT (raising $10,000) and deploy cash and proceeds into VOO (buying 30 shares for $15,000) and BND (buying 182 shares for $14,560). This leaves a cash balance of $11,200 (exactly 10.0%), stocks at $67,000 (59.82%), and bonds at $33,800 (30.18%), all within the ±0.5 percentage point tolerance around the targets using whole shares.
